_ayuda: Guion de la introducción de una partida nueva (el Profesor Birch). Se reproduce en orden.
{"dice": ["página 1", "página 2"]}       Birch habla (cada texto es una página; {nombre} = tu nombre, {inicial} = el tipo de tu mazo inicial).
{"quien": "Prof. Birch"}                     cambia el nombre que aparece arriba del cuadro de texto.
{"birch": "entra"} / {"birch": "sale"}    Birch aparece o se va (imagen: mundo/propios/intro/birch.png; sin imagen solo se ve el texto).

{"pokemon": "lotad", "accion": "sale"}     el Pokémon sale (con la tira de Birch se ve la animación de Rubí/Zafiro con Azurill; sin ella, el sprite de mundo/propios/pmd/<especie>); "vuelve" lo guarda.
{"carta": "ex2-31"} / {"carta": ""}            Birch muestra una carta (id de data/cards_adv.json; ex2-31 es Azurill de Sandstorm) o la guarda.
{"nombre": true}                              abre la pantalla para escribir tu nombre.
{"mazo": true}                                abre la pantalla para elegir el mazo inicial.
{"fin": true}                                 termina y empieza la campaña (data/campana.json, 'inicio').

dice: Ah, there you are! Come in, come in!
I'm Birch. Around here, people call me the Pokémon Professor.
This little one is Azurill. Say hello!
Here in Hoenn, people and Pokémon live side by side. Some travel together, some battle together...
...and some, like me, spend their days studying them!
But lately, Pokémon have turned up somewhere new. Take a look at this!
It's Azurill again... as a card!
This is the Pokémon Trading Card Game. Devon brought it to Hoenn not long ago.
Their designers asked researchers like me how each Pokémon really behaves...
...and turned it into HP, attacks, a type and a Weakness, all on one little card.
Build a deck, and you can have a Pokémon battle right on top of a table!
Now the whole region is crazy about them.
But I'm getting ahead of myself. First things first...
What's your name?
{nombre}! What a great name.
Listen, {nombre}. Starting tomorrow, the Trainer's School in Rustboro City opens its very first card course.
Anyone who passes gets a duelist license, and with it, the right to enter the Hoenn Card League.
I took the liberty of signing you up. I hope you don't mind!
Of course, every student needs a deck of their own. I brought three with me.
Go on, pick the one that suits you best!
The {inicial} deck! A fine choice.
Learn the rules, make some friends, and earn that license.
Your own adventure is about to begin, {nombre}. Good luck at school!
